stem: Meera's class in Pune is planning how to protect the local environment so that life around their school can thrive. Arjun says, 'If we just recycle the plastic bottles in our school canteen, all of Earth's life-supporting systems will be safe.' Why is Arjun's single action not enough on its own?

options.text: Because recycling plastic actually increases pollution in the air.
Because the hydrosphere, atmosphere, biosphere and geosphere are connected, so protecting life needs many linked actions such as saving water and energy and protecting biodiversity.
Because protecting life is only the job of governments, not of students and families.
Because one school is too small to make any difference to the environment at all.

teacher.key_rationale: B correctly states that Earth's systems are connected and protection requires multiple linked actions; A is factually false, C contradicts the idea of individual and community responsibility, and D falsely claims small actions are meaningless rather than insufficient alone.
